## Synopsis for "Warbringer"

[Diana](/wiki/Diana_of_Themyscira_(Warbringer) "Diana of Themyscira (Warbringer)") longs to prove herself to her [legendary warrior sisters](/wiki/Amazons_of_Themyscira "Amazons of Themyscira"). But when the opportunity finally comes, she throws away her chance at glory and breaks Amazon law, risking exile, to save a mere mortal. Even worse, [Alia Keralis](/wiki/Alia_Mayeux_Keralis_(Warbringer) "Alia Mayeux Keralis (Warbringer)") is no ordinary girl, and with this single brave act, Diana may have doomed the world.

Alia just wanted to escape her [overprotective brother](/wiki/Jason_Keralis_(Warbringer) "Jason Keralis (Warbringer)") with a semester at sea. She doesn't know she's being hunted. When a bomb detonates aboard her ship, Alia is rescued by a mysterious girl of extraordinary strength and forced to confront a horrible truth: Alia is a [Warbringer](/wiki/Warbringer "Warbringer") - a direct descendant of [Helen of Troy](/wiki/Helen_of_Sparta_(Warbringer) "Helen of Sparta (Warbringer)"), fated to bring about an age of bloodshed and misery.

Together, Diana and Alia will face an army of enemies - mortal and divine - determined to either destroy or possess the Warbringer. If they have any hope of saving both of their worlds, they will have to stand side-by-side against the tide of war.

## Notes

*   This one-shot is based on the [ novel of the same name](/wiki/Wonder_Woman:_Warbringer_(novel) "Wonder Woman: Warbringer (novel)") written by [Leigh Bardugo](/wiki/Leigh_Bardugo "Leigh Bardugo").

Release Date: September, 2019
